senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; בּוֹא) [that which is brought in,] grain, provision.
units: Ib. תבואה לחוד ותְבוּאַת וכ׳ t’buah is one thing (refers only to the five kinds of grain), and t’buath sadeh is another thing (refers to all in-gatherings of the field).
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:9">Peah VI, 9</cite> <he>סאה ת׳ עקורה וכ׳</he> a S’ah of plucked grain (forgotten in the field), and one of unplucked (standing) grain.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>ת׳ שנתנה לשחת</he> grain cut for fodder (v. <cite ref="U00726"><he>שַׁחַת</he> II</cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a:10">B. Mets. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם … בת׳ וכ׳</he> a man should always take care to have grain in his house, <he>שאין מריבה … על עסקי ת׳</he> for no strife is more frequent in the house than that about grain.

<cite ref="Menachot 103b:21">Men. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>הלוקח ת׳ משנה וכ׳</he> he who buys grain from year to year; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:5">Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵃ</cite> bot. <cite ref="H00633"><he>חטים</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Temurah 16a:45">Tem. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אשה כיון שאין לה ת׳ וכ׳</he> when a woman has no provision in the house, she clamors at once; a. fr.
